title: QB7_D#q15's source-confidence footer claimed closure over five IGF amendments and omitted MSC.458(101). The chain has six. All six are now held, read end to end and named - and q14 carried the same count word over an already-complete list
authorisation_source: Founder adjudication of the blocker raised by PRE-TRANCHE-3 BMP + IGF SOURCE-CUSTODY CLEANUP REPORT (5 September 2026), which directed that the locally held IGF amendment chain be completed FIRST and the footer corrected against the complete chain, rather than the count merely being changed from five to six over an incomplete corpus
candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. Raised by the source-custody repair that preceded it: acquiring MSC.551(108) and MSC.567(109) put the whole amendment chain in front of a completeness check for the first time, and the check found the card's enumeration short by one.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD ON THE ENUMERATION. The SUBSTANTIVE conclusion is unchanged and was independently re-established: no IGF amendment resolution amends the annex to part C-1 (the LNG Bunker Delivery Note). That was verified against all six resolutions read end to end, including the omitted MSC.458(101) and the two acquired in this session.

authority.chain: The IGF Code is adopted by MSC.391(95) (adopted 11 June 2015, in force 1 January 2017). Its amendment chain is SIX resolutions: MSC.422(98) adopted 15 June 2017 in force 1 January 2020; MSC.458(101) adopted 13 June 2019 in force 1 January 2024; MSC.475(102) adopted 11 November 2020 in force 1 January 2024; MSC.524(106) adopted 10 November 2022 in force 1 January 2026; MSC.551(108) adopted 23 May 2024 in force 1 January 2026; MSC.567(109) adopted 6 December 2024 in force 1 January 2028. Every date is read from the resolution's own operative clauses 2 and 3.
authority.base_is_not_an_amendment: MSC.391(95) is the adopting resolution and is NOT one of the six. Counting it would give seven and is the error in the opposite direction; the corrected footers say so explicitly so that a future editor does not make it.
authority.bdn_finding: None of the six amends the annex to part C-1. Established by reading each resolution end to end and searching each for 'Part C-1', 'Bunker Delivery Note', '18.4' and 'chapter 18'. MSC.422(98) deletes words from 11.3.2 only. MSC.458(101) touches 2.2.42, 5.3.4.2, 6.8, 9.5, 10.3.1.1.1, 11.3.3 and 11.3.3.1. MSC.475(102) touches 6.7.1.1, new 11.8 and 16.3.3.5.1. MSC.524(106) replaces Table 7.3 and nothing else. MSC.551(108) replaces 18.4.1.1.1 and 8.4.1 and adds 8.4.2 and 8.4.3 - it changes what must be AGREED before bunkering, not the BDN annex. MSC.567(109) is construction-gated to 1 January 2028 and touches neither chapter 8 nor chapter 18.

It recorded that an earlier footer claimed closure over four; it now also records that the version which replaced it claimed five while omitting MSC.458(101), and states that the omission was in the READING and not in the HOLDING - the corpus had held that resolution since 3 August 2026.

MSC.458(101)'s amendment scope is named in the footer (2.2.42, 5.3.4.2, 6.8, 9.5, 10.3.1.1.1, 11.3.3) so the reader can see WHY it does not disturb the conclusion, rather than being asked to take the closure on trust.

The footer now states that all six are held locally with recorded SHA-256 digests and were read end to end on 5 September 2026 - a claim that is reproducible from the manifest, which the previous wording was not.

cards.classification_note: FOUND BY THE PROPAGATION SWEEP THE FOUNDER DIRECTIVE ASKED FOR, AND IT IS NOT THE SAME DEFECT AS q15's. q14's enumeration is COMPLETE - it already named all six, MSC.458(101) included. What it shared with q15 was the COUNT WORD: 'All five IGF amendments were opened and read:' followed by five in-force resolutions and then 'plus MSC.567(109)'. Read on its own that is defensible, because five WERE in force; read beside a corrected q15 saying six, on the same page, it is a contradiction. This is the narrower half of the defect and it is corrected with one word rather than a rewrite.
changed_propositions: 'All five IGF amendments were opened and read:' -> 'All six IGF amendment resolutions were opened and read - MSC.391(95) adopts the Code itself and is not one of them:'. The base-resolution clarifier was added to this card because the gate demanded parity with q15: a reader who sees six on one card and no statement about the base on the other is one step from correcting six to seven. The list beneath it is unchanged and already totals six - five in-force resolutions with their dates, plus MSC.567(109) at 1 January 2028.
deliberately_unchanged: The whole enumeration, which was already correct and complete, including every entry-into-force date - all six were re-verified against the held resolutions in this session and every one is right.
The two corrections T2C and its predecessors recorded in this footer, which stay on the record.
The MSC.551(108) chapter 8 / ERC-ERS content, verified against the held resolution and unchanged.
